default_scope: R1 authorized implementation; prepare R2; integration deferred
dependency_semantics: Dependencies gate completion/external execution, not safe preparation while a genuine blocker remains.
status_meaning: PLANNED and verified=false describe future implementation work, not a claim every current feature is absent or failing.

stories.title: Reconcile baseline and preserve existing candidate
Correct routing with paired entry-point regression evidence
stories.deliverable: Explained narrow correction, controls and no-provider support-route checks.

stories.title: Correct auth-origin policy and phone target
stories.deliverable: Supported-origin configuration behavior and plain phone target.

stories.title: Verify writing, consent and activity behavior under interruption
stories.deliverable: Current contract regression evidence; fix concrete failures, not rewrite working features.

stories.title: Verify owner isolation, export and erasure fences
stories.deliverable: Two-owner and delayed-response checks; content-free diagnostics.

stories.title: Verify local account-closure state and freshness contract
stories.deliverable: Fault/concurrency/receipt checks and staged smoke preparation.

stories.title: Perform authorized encrypted export and isolated local restore
stories.deliverable: Actual recovery receipt and accurate operational scope.
stories.external_dependency: Secure database input, private passphrase, Docker/GPG, authorized intended source; no credential reset implied.

stories.title: Qualify exact staged closure capability
stories.deliverable: Compatible migration/readiness and actual disposable hosted smoke.
stories.external_dependency: Scoped hosted access and current authorization for migration/staging/disposable cleanup; production enablement remains gated.

stories.title: Freeze repaired inference and qualify AI under predeclared policy
stories.deliverable: New immutable bundle, shared-ledger integrity, actual model report plus separate human review and decision.
stories.external_dependency: Existing shared budget ledger, secure provider credential and paid-run authorization; independent human reviewer.

stories.title: Finalize release evidence and authorized hosted promotion
stories.deliverable: Current CI/evidence manifest, observed hosted identity, rollback/support record.
stories.external_dependency: Current deployment authorization/access if promotion is requested; otherwise release-ready work and exact blocker.

stories.title: Prepare minimal measurement and run five moderated sessions
stories.deliverable: Scoped accessibility fixes, tested consent/retention, real task results and separate retests.
stories.external_dependency: Five actual consenting adults, moderator, approved candidate; no fabricated observations.

stories.title: Observe voluntary use for seven days and make a product decision
stories.deliverable: 168-hour cohort accounting, reproducible metrics, support findings and next-investment decision.
stories.external_dependency: Fresh pilot enrollment, real elapsed observation windows and human feedback.

stories.title: Optional one-destination approved-action integration
stories.deliverable: One bound adapter/outbox with honest uncertainty, erasure fences and actual provider proof.
stories.external_dependency: G6a discovery/scope approval; G6b enablement qualification, delegated account/API access, scoped external-write authorization and deployment-supported dispatcher.

stories.title: Publish-ready evidence and personal ownership walkthrough
stories.deliverable: Case study, product/technical demos, guide/runbook and exact claims.
stories.external_dependency: Yusen's actual walkthrough and separate publication authorization if publishing is requested.
